assertion_results.text: Bug parsing correctly extracts all four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) using the heading formats from bug-template-mock.md (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lists all four required sections under 'Parsed Description Sections > Required Sections', each marked '(Present)' with extracted content: 'Issue Description (Present)' (line 28), 'Steps to Reproduce (Present)' (line 36), 'Expected Result (Present)' (line 45), 'Actual Result (Present)' (line 50). The bug-template-mock.md heading formats (### **Issue Description**, ### **Steps to Reproduce**, ### **Expected Result**, ### **Actual Result**) are the basis for section extraction.

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md line 39: 'The divergence occurs at `line[3:]` in the heading extraction. The code does not call `.strip()` or `.rstrip()` on the extracted section name, causing trailing whitespace from the source file to propagate into the dictionary key used for later lookups.' Line 105: 'The bug is a single-root-cause defect: `line[3:]` in the heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace, causing exact-match lookup failures downstream.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md: WHAT -- 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which captures all characters after the `## ` prefix without stripping trailing whitespace' (lines 9-11). WHERE -- 'The plan-feature skill\'s convention conformance analysis' (line 9). HOW TO VERIFY -- Reproducer Strategy section (lines 36-43): 'Create a test CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on at least one heading' and assert extraction and matching behavior.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion — before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md line 63 (first acceptance criterion): '- [ ] Reproducer test: a test with a CONVENTIONS.md fixture containing trailing whitespace on a `## ` heading demonstrates that the convention is correctly matched and included in the generated task output (test fails before fix, passes after)'. This precedes fix criteria on lines 64-67.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement — with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
